*Je relaye un message de <@U0DK05RS5> de NeuroTechX*


___
We’re excited to formally introduce you to *NeuroTechX (NTX) Services*, NTX’ collaborating entity when it comes to technical, strategic, and financial services for the neurotechnology industry.

*NTX Services*

NTX Services was created *to provide our talented community members with opportunities* including jobs, working on consulting mandates (e.g., technical, project management), as well as financial/strategic advice for your startups and other projects. The Job Board we launched a few months ago (<http://neurotechx.com/jobs|neurotechx.com/jobs>) was a first step in that direction!

While we’ve only recently started providing services, we’ve already successfully conducted both Consulting (e.g., Preparing a BCI prototype, Developing a Go-to-Market Strategy, Reviewing a fundraising approach), and Headhunting mandates (e.g., Identifying a BCI Machine Learning Engineer for a growing startup), reinforcing NTX’ mission to bring the neurotechnology field forward.


*Headhunting Services & Referral Fees*

Specifically for headhunting services, we don’t just want to find opportunities for our members, we also want to *allow you to benefit from your own network of neurotech talent*.

In that regard, for every headhunting mandate contracted by NTX Services, *NTX members which successfully refer us* to the selected/hired candidate (for that specific mandate) will get *15% of the total* (pre-tax) *fee* NTX Services is making on that contract.
The rest of the mandate fee will be used to cover NeuroTechX and NeuroTechX Services’ operational expenses and future growth.
_(simply put: you get paid for knowing people in the field)_


*Current Jobs/Referral opportunities*
Regarding current postings with potential referrals, here are 3 positions for companies we’re currently working with:
> > Chercheur en sciences du comportement (Paris; French)
> > Head of Research (Paris; French)
> > Scientific Advisor (Remote; English)


For more information and/or for referrals on any of the above position, please contact Adam Sefler who’s leading NTX Services. (<@U5S4DHPKP> -- <mailto:adamsefler@neurotechx.com|adamsefler@neurotechx.com>)

<https://neurotechx.com/ntx-services/>
